title: Post Events Schema
description: Event schemas for post lifecycle, photos, matching, and claiming in the Lost & Found platform

resolved_by.description: User who resolved the post (if different from post owner)

post.description: Complete post data with updated photos array

ai_processing_trigger.description: Whether this photo addition should trigger AI enhancement

time_difference_hours.description: Time difference between posts in hours

involved_users.description: Privacy-safe user contexts for both involved users

original_post.description: Complete original post data before enhancement

tags.description: AI-extracted tags with confidence and source tracking

model_versions.description: AI model versions used for traceability

ai_analysis.description: Comprehensive AI analysis data and metrics

notify_user.description: Whether to notify user of enhancement

significant_changes.description: List of significant changes to highlight

match_duration_hours.description: How long the match was active in hours

processing_time_ms.description: Time taken for processing in milliseconds

contact_exchange_initiated.description: Whether contact exchange was automatically initiated

contact_request_id.description: ID of contact exchange request if initiated
